recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the FHIR-32500 application by removing a semantic typo from the WG-approved rendering clarification; broader shared-datatype wording would be a separate PA decision, not required for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-32500 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA change request for R5 asking for comments explaining that systems may render availability differently than the wire representation, with placement on PractitionerRole.availableTime and parallel application to HealthcareService.availableTime and Location.hoursOfOperation.
initial_application: Commit 77446ad94209db50fb0712364dbc2bff0e6e488a, merged through PR #2011 by 496b7c217c8b72487d236e709cd22e3ece4a1112, added the requested rendering comments to the three resource definitions. That application satisfied the placement request but introduced `9am-12am` and `9-12am`, which incorrectly reads as midnight rather than noon.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Location, PractitionerRole, and HealthcareService in the active resource build scope and maps their old R4/R5 availability elements to the current Availability-based elements. Later FHIR-25381/FHIR-26641 refactoring preserved the rendering comments on the corresponding resource elements, and FHIR-41311 updates to Availability.availableTime.period do not alter this issue. PA WGM minutes confirm the 7-0-0 persuasive-with-modification vote; Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed only the misleading time examples in source/practitionerrole/structuredefinition-PractitionerRole.xml, source/healthcareservice/structuredefinition-HealthcareService.xml, and source/location/structuredefinition-Location.xml from `9am-12am`/`9-12am` to `9am-12pm`/`9am-12pm`, preserving the approved rendering guidance and current resource placement.
source_changes: source/practitionerrole/structuredefinition-PractitionerRole.xml: corrected the PractitionerRole.availability rendering example to end the morning interval at 12pm and render the compact display as `Mon-Fri 9am-12pm and 1pm-5pm`.
source/healthcareservice/structuredefinition-HealthcareService.xml: corrected the HealthcareService.availability rendering example from midnight wording to noon wording.
source/location/structuredefinition-Location.xml: corrected the Location.hoursOfOperation rendering example from midnight wording to noon wording.
